name: Multiresolution Maximum Intensity Projection (MMIP)
aliases: MIP Volume Rendering with Morphological Pyramids
Multiresolution MIP based on detail pyramid
definition: A progressive rendering method for MIP volume data using morphological pyramids, projecting detail coefficients level by level from coarsest to finest to refine the image.
summary: Multiresolution Maximum Intensity Projection is a progressive rendering algorithm that uses morphological pyramids to provide interactive coarse approximations and progressively refine images by projecting on coarse levels and expanding in 2-D.
